basic_info.description: Experience refined San Francisco living in this timeless and remodeled Queen Anne style condo. Just 1/2 a block from Alta Plaza Park and steps from Fillmore Street's vibrant dining and boutique shopping scene, this move-in-ready residence offers the perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The curved bay windows, tree-lined block, and stunning architectural details highlight this home's beautiful exterior. Inside, natural light pours through every window, emphasizing soaring ceilings & beautiful millwork. The ideal floorplan consists of 3 beds and 2.5 baths flowing seamlessly from the spacious kitchen, dining, and living rooms at the front to the bedrooms located at the back. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, outfitted with top-of-the-line Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry, and refined finishes. The primary suite feels like a private retreat with its spa-inspired bath and walk-out deck. 2 additional bedrooms and 1.5 additional bathrooms complete the condo. With a remarkable Walk Score of 95, seamless access to public transportation, garage parking, in-unit laundry, and all of SF's best just steps away, this home is a rare find in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods
